author: xRice
body: This is the user xRice reporting a false ban that happened over a year ago. the reason why i was so called "ban" was because my friend  got on to my account and played and did im not sure but a block gilcth so im pretty sure a emerald player banned me by the name of alexanderjoe. The reason why i want to be un-banned is because i was stunned at how great the community is and when watching my friend play i fell in love with the server again and i just wanted to fix this mix up. Thank you

replies.author: izjust4fun
replies.body:
Hey Rice!

I've decided to appeal your ban due to the fact that you were punished a very long time ago. Please do keep in mind though that you are your responsible for all actions associated with your account, and if you're caught hacking again you will no longer have the chance to appeal. So please be more careful with who you let on your account next time! 

But welcome back and enjoy the server :)
